supporting_observations.claim: During the alerted interval, WS-RDIAZ-01 made repeated connections to the internal proxy at 10.56.20.30:8080; examples occur at 13:38:08, 13:42:37, 13:47:05, 13:52:52, 13:57:28, 14:02:36, and 14:07:10 UTC.

The intervals between those proxy connections are roughly five minutes, broadly consistent with the cadence of the approved GradeBook Pro updater, but the available records do not attribute these connections to that updater.
The listed network records describe HTTP connections to the internal proxy, not the external HTTPS destination or service contacted through it.

known_telemetry_limitations: The provided records show proxy connections but do not include proxy request details identifying the external destination, URL, or TLS hostname. The relevant records identify the proxy as 10.56.20.30:8080 and the service as HTTP: T276-00200, T276-00208, T276-00248, T276-00291, T276-00319, T276-00332, T276-00368.
The provided records do not link the repeated proxy connections to a process or executable on WS-RDIAZ-01.
claims_not_established: Whether the periodic connections reached update.gradebookpro.com or another destination.
Whether GradeBook Pro, another approved application, or an unapproved process generated the connections.
Whether the alert's characterization as outbound HTTPS is confirmed by proxy or endpoint telemetry.
Whether the traffic carried malicious content or involved command-and-control.
additional_evidence_needed: PROXY-ORC-01 logs for the relevant timestamps, including CONNECT requests, destination hostnames, URLs where available, TLS SNI, response codes, and byte counts.
Endpoint network-to-process telemetry for WS-RDIAZ-01 during 13:30–14:10 UTC, including executable path, signature, command line, and user context.
Verification of the GradeBook Pro updater installation and its activity or logs on WS-RDIAZ-01 during the alert window.
unrelated_findings: GoogleUpdater.exe started as SYSTEM on WS-RDIAZ-01 at 14:17 UTC, after the alerted activity interval; the supplied approved-software context does not list Google software. Validate separately; this does not determine the alert disposition. (T276-00438, T276-00439)

WS-RDIAZ-01 established an SMB connection to DC-ORC-01 at 14:09 UTC. This is separate from the observed proxy connections and merits independent context review; it does not determine the alert disposition. (T276-00412, T276-00413, T276-00416)
